reason: This PR changes planner cardinality/cost estimation for `ORDER BY ... LIMIT` index scans and adds session/sysvar plumbing to control that behavior. Cost-model and selectivity changes can silently alter plan selection across many queries, and the session variable surface expands the runtime blast radius beyond a narrow local fix. That is central enough to planner semantics and risky enough to justify a focused deep review for high-severity regressions.
